g.text: Authenticated mission snapshots: WebSocket every 2 s.
Web interface also polls selected mission every 5 s.
Completion: armed then disarmed, not CANCELLING,
reached >= total - 2. Cancellation resolves to CANCELLED.
Runner error: attempt runtime stop, record FAILED with error,
preserve coverage and release the lease. Startup/restart never
automatically resumes an unfinished flight. FR-28-FR-46.
